## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `intercom-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create an Intercom account

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to the [Intercom website](https://www.intercom.com/) and sign up or log in. -->
2. Ensure you have a paid plan (Starter or higher) — API access is not available on the free trial.

## Step 3: Generate an API access token

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your Intercom account. -->
2. Navigate to **Settings** (gear icon in the top-right corner) and select **For Developers** from the left sidebar.
3. In the Developer Hub, select **Your Apps**, then select **New app** or choose an existing app.
4. <!-- manual: Go to the Configure tab and scroll down to the Access Token section to generate your token. -->
